users.revealBody: Full email and phone are shown once and this action is recorded in the audit log with your reason.

restaurants.intro: Every merchant seen on receipts, partner or not. Figures are observed through Epsilon, not restaurant revenue.

reviews.moderateBody: Hidden reviews are excluded from ratings and public lists. The text is never changed and this can be reversed. The action is recorded in the audit log.

receipts.originalNames: Names exactly as printed on the receipt.

product.eventsNotStarted: Not tracked yet — event collection not started.

costs.estimates: All cost figures are estimates based on call counts, not invoices.

reports.note: Exports are audited: who, what and when are recorded. Each file is limited to 50 000 rows and uses the date range selected above.
reports.confirmBody: {{report}} for {{range}}. This export is recorded in the audit log.

desc.restaurants: Merchants with receipts, ratings and averages.
desc.receipts: Imported receipts with provider and status.

settings.name: Name
settings.sessionNote: Sessions end after 30 minutes of inactivity or 8 hours in total. Sign-in is handled by the access gateway.

metrics.totalUsers: Users rows that are not deleted.
metrics.newUsers: Users created in the selected range.
metrics.activeUser: A user who, that Baku day, signed in or refreshed a session, claimed a receipt, or submitted or edited a review. DAU, WAU and MAU use the last 1, 7 and 30 days ending at the end of the range.
metrics.receiptsImported: Claimed purchases, counted once per purchase. Unique fiscal receipts are counted separately.
metrics.uniqueRestaurants: Distinct merchant keys with at least one imported receipt.
metrics.ratings: Feedback rows. An edit does not add a rating. Hidden (moderated) reviews are excluded.
metrics.avgRating: Mean of the current ratings in the range.
metrics.receiptToRatingRate: Imported receipts with at least one rating divided by imported receipts.
metrics.returningUserPct: Users with two or more distinct active days in the range divided by active users.
metrics.activePartners: Partner restaurants with activity in the range.
metrics.cashbackConfirmedMinor: Ledger entries of type earned with status confirmed. Demo and test data is excluded.
metrics.cashbackConfirmed: Ledger entries of type earned with status confirmed. Demo and test data is excluded.
metrics.cashbackPending: Earned cashback that is not confirmed yet.
metrics.cashbackReversed: Cashback taken back after it was earned.
metrics.cashbackLiability: Confirmed cashback not yet spent or expired.
metrics.observed: Sum of receipt totals seen through Epsilon. This is observed purchase value, never restaurant revenue.
metrics.observedValueMinor: Sum of receipt totals seen through Epsilon. This is observed purchase value, never restaurant revenue.
metrics.receipts: Imported receipts for this merchant, counted once per purchase.
metrics.reviewers: Distinct users who rated this merchant.
metrics.purchases: Times this dish was seen on imported receipts.
metrics.positivePct: Share of ratings with positive feedback.
metrics.negativePct: Share of ratings with negative feedback.
metrics.minSample: Rankings only include items with at least the minimum number of ratings. The sample size is always shown.
metrics.dimensions: For each feedback dimension, the share of positive, neutral and negative quick comments.
metrics.scannedNeverRated: Users with at least one receipt and no rating.
metrics.ratedNonPartner: Ratings given to merchants that are not Epsilon partners.
metrics.notificationOptInRate: Users with at least one notification category enabled.
metrics.pushDevices: Registered push devices. Delivery is not tracked yet.
metrics.optIn: Users who have each category switched on.
metrics.geminiCalls: Receipt-reading calls to the Gemini model.
metrics.geminiEstimate: Estimated from call counts and the stated basis. Not an invoice.
